title: The Underdog Raider — Ark Riders Emotional Story
concept: Viral emotional story: a struggling raider gets mocked by others, but finds legendary loot and saves the same people who laughed at him. Moral: don't judge people by their gear.

narrative_arc.climax: Возвращается к тем же рейдерам, делится лутом, те в шоке — мораль
